subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should this remain the canonical multi-agent Telegram/provider timeout investigation, or should maintainers split the remaining work into narrower runtime, Telegram, and provider-policy issues now that the terminal-abort mitigation has merged?
rationale: The report combines a real reliability symptom with multiple possible owner boundaries, and current source shows only partial mitigation rather than a proven root-cause fix.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Reproduce
options.body: Keep this issue open, run a current-main four-agent Telegram/provider repro, and split only the confirmed residual causes afterward.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Create or designate narrower canonical items for Telegram runner concurrency, provider fast-fail policy, and launch environment tuning, then use this issue only as the umbrella reference.

options.title: Treat As Environment Tuning
options.body: Deprioritize source changes and document operator tuning only if maintainers decide the remaining symptoms are deployment-specific rather than product reliability defects.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Reproduce
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, run a current-main four-agent Telegram/provider repro, and split only the confirmed residual causes afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-fallback ownership plus timeline involvement make this the best available owner for the agent/provider policy decision.
